newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Brazil not barring Philippine coconuts, says envoy.
newsitem.headline: Brazil not barring Philippine coconuts, says envoy.

text.p: Brazil has not prevented the entry of Philippine coconuts into its markets, the Brazilan ambassador to Manila Luiz Amado said.

"It is a totally groundless allegation that the Brazilian Ministry of Agriculture and Supply has been blocking imports of Philippine coconut products as they are supposedly contaminated with fungi," Amado said in a letter to the Philippine Foreign Affairs Department.
The letter, a copy of which was given to Reuters on Wednesday, said Brazil did not adopt any restrictive trade measures.

Officials of the state-agency Philippine Coconut Authority (PCA) had expressed worries over Brazilian newspaper reports that Philippine dessicated coconut products were found to be contaminated with fungi.
Philippine officials said the country's dessicated coconut exports to Brazil dropped to around 600 tonnes last year from the previous year's 7,500 tonnes.
